detailed_notes.testing_approach: Single browser session with 24-hour token as instructed. Tested forms end-to-end with data verification in lists, not just toast messages.
detailed_notes.console_logs: Only expected warnings present: WebSocket connection warnings (expected when switching pages), CDN/rum requests (external), PostHog analytics. No red console errors found.

detailed_notes.label_functionality: Tested on 3 dialogs as required - all labels correctly linked to fields via htmlFor/id attributes. Clicking label text moves focus to correct input field.
